proven_claims: The GanttChart object payload's own top-level shape is `{19, <32 more top-level fields>}` -- 33 fields total, NOT the 3-field `{19,{0,{11},{74,...}}}` a prior wave's unsaved notes summarized. Field[1] is that `{0,{11},{74,...}}` triple (the plain-Chart `parse_moxel_chart`-compatible payload, confirmed identical shape to moxel.rs's own `{74,...}` tuple); fields[2..33) are GanttChart-specific and undecoded.

field[2] and field[3] each correlate with one of native XML's `<d3p1:points>`/`<d3p1:series>` cache-template blocks: field[2]'s nested `baseData`-shaped number (4294927473 in the first example, 4294901761 in the second) matches `<d3p1:points><d3p1:value><d3p1:baseData>` exactly; field[3]'s matches `<d3p1:series><d3p1:value><d3p1:baseData>` exactly. Field ORDER within the nested nested tuple, and which of the many other points/series sub-elements (testMode, contentCacheItem's colours, autoText, useValuesReverseBehavior) map to which slot, is NOT decoded.

field[12], field[13] and field[14] are dates in a fixed 14-digit `YYYYMMDDHHMMSS` numeric-string format (no separators), matching `<d3p1:fullIntervalBegin>`, `<d3p1:fullIntervalEnd>` and `<d3p1:visualBegin>` (ISO `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`) respectively in both examples -- confirmed by literal string equality once dashes/colons/`T` are stripped, e.g. `20160701000000` == `2016-07-01T00:00:00`.
non_claims: Fields[4..12) and [15..33) of the wrapper are NOT decoded at all -- only spot-checked that they exist and are plausible types (small integers, one nested `{3,0,1,{8,...}}` tuple at field[7] that is probably `timeScale`/`level`, given field[8]/[9] look like `measure`/`interval` codes and field[7] sits right before the three dates). This is a first-pass read, not a proof.

The native XML carries roughly 55 elements after `</d3p1:chart>` (see docs/evidence/ut-diagram-remainder-20260825.md); this fixture's two examples are both template/placeholder Gantt charts (no real tasks/intervals) from the SAME UT distribution -- no seed variation has been attempted, so nothing here is proven independent of anything else that happens to differ between the two native examples (chartType differs: one native XML resolves to `Column3D`, matching a previously-unseen `moxel_chart_type` code that still needs adding).

No decoder exists yet for any of this. This fixture exists purely to preserve raw bytes + native XML so a future wave does not have to re-extract them, per the recommendation in docs/evidence/ut-diagram-remainder-20260825.md.
